title: Create app_spacing.dart token file
description: Create the spacing tokens file at lib/ui/core/tokens/app_spacing.dart. Wrap constants in class `Spacing` with private constructor `Spacing._();`. Base unit is 4px. Required constants (all `static const double`): `xxs` = 4.0, `xs` = 8.0, `sm` = 12.0, `md` = 16.0, `lg` = 24.0, `xl` = 32.0, `xxl` = 48.0, `xxxl` = 64.0, `xxxxl` = 80.0 (additionally a `xxxxs` for 2.0 hairline gaps if used). Common combinations: `pagePaddingMobile` = 16.0, `pagePaddingTablet` = 24.0, `pagePaddingDesktop` = 32.0, `cardPadding` = 16.0, `sectionGap` = 24.0, `listItemVerticalPadding` = 12.0. Naming follows the project's camelCase convention — convert DESIGN_PLAN's `space_xs` style to `xs` (Dart idiom is short camelCase suffixes, e.g. `xxs` not `space_2xs`). Top-of-file doc comment: explains 4px base, lists each token's pixel value, and lists common combinations.
acceptance_criteria: All spacing constants declared inside class `Spacing` (with private constructor `Spacing._();`)
All constants are `static const double` (compile-time evaluable)
Token values match DESIGN_PLAN section 1.4: xxs 4.0, xs 8.0, sm 12.0, md 16.0, lg 24.0, xl 32.0, xxl 48.0, xxxl 64.0, xxxxl 80.0 (plus optional xxs/xxxxs 2.0)
Common combinations present: pagePaddingMobile 16.0, pagePaddingTablet 24.0, pagePaddingDesktop 32.0, cardPadding 16.0, sectionGap 24.0, listItemVerticalPadding 12.0
All constants use camelCase (project naming convention)
All string literals use double quotes
No emojis anywhere in the file
Top-of-file doc comment describes base unit (4px) and purpose
completion_summary: Created lib/ui/core/tokens/app_spacing.dart with 10 spacing tokens + 6 common combinations, flutter analyze passes
